verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email service, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows Fastmail offers a self-hostable version of its product. The JMAP material describes an open protocol that any organisation can implement, and the server entry in the jmap.io implementation list is a protocol-ecosystem item. Neither is a Fastmail self-hosting capability, so both are adjacent developer building blocks that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
